LanguageData.MooGirl_BrainWashing_Level1.label: Brainwashing Lv. 1 (First Brainwashing)
LanguageData.MooGirl_BrainWashing_Level1.description: Yes... yes... I obey your command...
LanguageData.MooGirl_BrainWashing_Level2.label: Brainwashing Lv. 2 (Brainwashing Trance)
LanguageData.MooGirl_BrainWashing_Level2.description: Huh? Eh? What just happened, why am I standing here...
LanguageData.MooGirl_BrainWashing_Level3.label: Brainwashing Lv. 3 (Brainwashing Again)
LanguageData.MooGirl_BrainWashing_Level3.description: Yes... yes... hehe... Mechanical-sama is the best~♥
LanguageData.MooGirl_BrainWashing_Level4.label: Brainwashing Lv. 4 (Brainwashing Dizziness)
LanguageData.MooGirl_BrainWashing_Level4.description: Ugh.... my head is so dizzy... did I space out again... it must be this damn helmet, but why... my body feels so comfortable (whisper)
LanguageData.MooGirl_BrainWashing_Level5.label: Brainwashing Lv. 5 (Brainwashing Complete)
LanguageData.MooGirl_BrainWashing_Level5.description: Understand... I understand... kill... kill them all... the colonists... not a single one left... kill them all!
LanguageData.MooGirl_EleShock.label: Collar Electric Shock
LanguageData.MooGirl_EleShock.description: For some reason, the electric shock collar started electrocuting the Mugirl, fortunately it was only a mild shock.
LanguageData.MooGirl_MagneticShacklesBondage.label: Magnetic Shackles Bondage
LanguageData.MooGirl_MagneticShacklesBondage.descript: The Mugirl's arms were strictly restrained to the Mugirl's neck by the suddenly activated magnetic shackles, unable to move.
LanguageData.MooGirl_PowerEleShock.label: Powerful Collar Electric Shock
LanguageData.MooGirl_PowerEleShock.description: For some reason, the electric shock collar started strongly electrocuting the Mugirl. Stop it quickly! It could really kill the Mugirl!
LanguageData.MooGirl_PowerEleShock_NoMilk.label: Powerful Collar Electric Shock
LanguageData.MooGirl_PowerEleShock_NoMilk.description: For some reason, the electric shock collar started strongly electrocuting the wearer.
